generation.ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
generation.label_threshold: Transformed emitted clean PCM normalized to -20 dBFS RMS; max(-48 dBFS, peak 10 ms frame RMS minus 40 dB)
generation.limitations: Synthetic English TTS only. No human labels or natural breaths. Repeated phase variants and paired prefixes are correlated; two voices per split do not establish human, language or microphone generalization.
generation.selection_policy: Entire design and test manifest frozen before any model scoring or development selection
generation.split_policy: Disjoint voices, exact texts and record RNG seeds within this corpus; same Flite engine in both splits
generation.turn_policy: Construction intent defines turn identity; one resumed turn spans the inserted internal pause. RMS proxy defines nominal acoustic boundaries.
generation.uncertainty: 20 ms RMS-transition collars, subthreshold emitted support, conservative exact PCM support bounds; artificial breath-like tail uncertain and not labeled speech
